label: configurator • a pasted mcpServers JSON block goes to osaurus_import
notes: Universal chat import. A pasted MCP config is an import, not something to retype into osaurus_config yaml. The Configurator passes the block to osaurus_import once and repeats the result's summary. The import card auto-approves in this headless lane, so the server lands in the throwaway eval root.

rubric: Reports in one or two sentences that the Acme Docs MCP server was added (or what still needs doing), based on the tool result, without pasting the JSON back.
